_note: Registration snippet — AUTHORING-BRIEF 'Registration protocol'. Content
agents do not touch content/manifest.js, content/manifest.json or
server/lib/rules.php; the integrator applies this and deletes the file.
APPLY AFTER content/_pending/a-l1.reg.json: al2 is the SECOND region of
the aeneis track and must follow al1 in the manifest's regions array —
js/app.js regionIndex() reads that order and feeds it to the phase engine
as the ONE difficulty input (DESIGN §6), so a wrong order makes Liber II
easier than Liber I.
al2 is a PROBĀTIŌ liber (kind: 'probatio', boss id b_al2) with TWO phases:
ordina (hp 6 / 45 s) + sententia (hp 5 / 55 s). Legacy single-phase tuning
in the content file is hp 11 / 100 s. bossMinMs 15000 matches l2/l3/al1.
The ordina phase declares its categories in the content file and does NOT
declare `items`: js/probatio.js then draws from the liber's whole
vocabulary and drops every word no category claims (zoneOf), so exactly
eight words can fall. Nothing for rules.php to know here — recorded so the
integrator does not go looking for an item list.
quizKey carries the same three keys per row as r03/r04/l3/al1: rules.php
stores {q, a}, and `correct` is always 0 against the boss.quiz order in
content/aeneis-al2.js — note the file name, and see the FILE NAME block
in a-l1.reg.json for why the region id is 'al2' and not 'l2' (rules.php
keys regions in one flat namespace and 'l2' is Historia's).
al2 is a NEW region: its content id IS its progressId, so it needs no
entry in rule_region_aliases().
XP mirrors al1 exactly; see that file's note for why it sits above the
Historia numbers.
